title: Test exact recovery of a reset-originated Unknown checkpoint after its reset fence is released
outcome: A regression drives an Unknown checkpoint created by the bounded project-reset path, retains its reset-owner generation across settings restoration and state reload, then recovers through the existing owner with an identical request and confirmed canonical settlement.
acceptance: A test creates an Unknown checkpoint through a bounded project reset, verifies that its original checkpoint owner generation is present and the reset fence is released, and that restoring same-authority gating sends no checkpoint or bind and leaves its request and exclusion intact.

The existing recovery owner replays the complete original checkpoint request, including report and idempotency key, after settings restoration or state reload; the canonical original identity is unchanged, settlement becomes Confirmed, and exclusion is released only on the matching accepted receipt.
